$comment: Named, versioned machine-verification suite for cinatra-ai/docs — the gate-arm half of the truthful verification-record model (the Truthful Attribution protocol §4). The truthful-attribution-gate reads THIS file at the merged SHA (authoritative, no TOCTOU) when a merge record carries a Gate-suite arm: the cited suiteId@version must equal this file's, the Accountable trailer must equal accountable{github,name,email}, and every requiredContexts entry must have concluded success on the reviewed head. requiredContexts names exactly the contexts this repository's main ruleset requires, each with the cinatra-ai/ci reusable workflow its caller under .github/workflows/ calls and the sha that caller pins, plus the truthful-attribution-gate context by name: that gate's engine pin lives in its own caller's uses: line (itself a high-risk path), so the entry carries callerPath and allowedEvents together with the reusable workflow it calls and the engine sha that caller pins (7c767fe7fabc5e4fb93e2142987a2b2dff502014), which the merge road reads. highRiskPaths is the UNION of the central cinatra-ai/ci defaults (config/high-risk-defaults.json) at BOTH engine shas — the 28 globs at 8eede1022e835997d94974e4bd6205daf72131a2, the engine this repository's attribution caller pinned at the suite's birth (it now pins 7c767fe7fabc5e4fb93e2142987a2b2dff502014, whose defaults are the same 35 globs), and the 35 globs at 416a75707fdcfeb768b41c3a54f944078d1ab8fc, the engine the merge road reads (a strict superset of the first, adding the docs-publish-pipeline class) — so the gate's superset check, which fails closed otherwise, passes at either engine; this repository ships documentation only and has no release or publish script of its own, and the .github surface and the suite file itself are already central defaults, so it adds nothing beyond that union. High-risk changes (this file is itself one — see **/gate-suite.json) require the HUMAN arm at tier=maintainer; the gate arm alone is rejected, so this file's birth carries a maintainer Reviewed-by, not a self-blessing gate arm. lastAuditedAt + auditEvidence are the §4 monthly-audit record; the Accountable engineer re-audits monthly and bumps BOTH coupled in one commit (the gate warns >35d, fails the gate arm >65d; the human arm is always still available).
auditEvidence: 2026-11-14 re-audit: all 5 requiredContexts exist at main - actions-pinned-gate.yml, gitignore-gate.yml, source-leak-gate.yml, secret-scan-gate.yml, truthful-attribution-gate.yml - and the caller jobs with the called jobs of the same ids produce the declared context names; pins 4c903fe9 (actions-pinned-gate), 4c903fe9 (gitignore-gate), 00ac7b92 (source-leak-gate), a8677e50 (secret-scan-gate), 7c767fe7 (truthful-attribution-gate) equal their callers' uses: SHAs and, where the caller passes one, its ref: input (the secret-scan-gate caller passes no ref: input); the truthful-attribution-gate callerPath equals that caller's own path and its allowedEvents (pull_request, push, merge_group) cover that caller's triggers (pull_request, push), merge_group declared with no such trigger; 7c767fe7 is a supported engine SHA of the merge road (grant revision 3) and the attribution caller runs the same commit; the central high-risk defaults read version 2026.06 with 35 globs at each of the nine supported engine SHAs and all 35 are in the 35 highRiskPaths (none missing; 0 repository extensions); accountable unchanged (Sandro Groganz, sandro@cinatra.ai, groganz); recorded, not changed: the active branch ruleset requiring actions-pinned-gate, gitignore-gate, secret-scan-gate, source-leak-gate, and every suite context concluded success at the main head read. Commands: checkout reads of the suite and its callers, git reads of the called reusable workflows at their pins and of config/high-risk-defaults.json at each supported engine, ruleset and check-run reads. The attribution row gains the workflow/pinned pair of engine 7c767fe7 (grant revision 3), and the caller advances from 8eede102 to 7c767fe7 in its uses: line and ref: input, with mode warn and the caller's other inputs and its permissions unchanged; the version moves from 2026.09.1 to 2026.11.1, as a new pin is a material suite change.
